rationale: Both Sina and Diego are San Francisco-based founders building AI-powered systems, and their skill sets are highly complementary. Sina is expanding Tuurny's engineering team to scale computer vision and robotics capabilities for e-waste recycling, while Diego brings deep experience in AI development across multiple languages (JavaScript, Swift, Ruby, C). With Tuurny currently raising seed to launch paid pilots, this could be a natural fit to explore whether Diego's AI expertise aligns with accelerating Tuurny's technical roadmap.
intro_message: Sina Ghashghaei, meet Diego Prats — both SF founders scaling AI systems, and Diego's full-stack AI development background could complement Sina's push to expand Tuurny's engineering team as they launch paid pilots.
